                "LOSTag": "B.3 Forecasting techniques",
                "Difficulty": "Moderate-Easy",
                "ItemType": "MCQ",
                "ItemStyle": "single-select",
                "Stem": "Beacon believes sales depend on advertising spend and housing starts. Which response is most appropriate?",
                "Choices": {
                        "A": "Use a causal forecasting model such as regression to estimate relationships among variables",
                        "B": "Treat the relation as a responsibility-center report",
                        "C": "Use reciprocal cost allocation",
                        "D": "Use simple exponential smoothing without any explanatory variables"
                },
                "CorrectChoice": "A",
                "ExplanationCorrect": "Causal forecasting uses explanatory variables to predict the variable of interest.",

                "ExplanationWrongB": "A responsibility-center report is an internal control and performance measurement tool, not a forecasting technique. Causal forecasting uses statistical methods like regression to quantify and predict those relationships.",
                "ExplanationWrongC": "Reciprocal cost allocation is a service department cost allocation method used in cost accounting, not a forecasting technique.
